subject: math
question: 求微分方程 $\cos^4 x \frac{\mathrm{d}^2 y}{\mathrm{d}x^2} + 2 \cos^2 x (1 - \sin x \cos x) \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} + y = \tan x$ 的通解.

steps.text:
分析 方程是二阶变系数线性微分方程, 不易直接求解. 注意到 $\frac{1}{\cos^2 x} \mathrm{d}x = \mathrm{d}\tan x$ , 令 $\tan x = t$ , 可将方程化为常系数.

令 $\tan x = t$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} & = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \sec^ {2} x, \\ \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} & = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \sec^ {2} x\right) = \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} \sec^ {2} x + \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot 2 \sec^ {2} x \tan x \\ & = \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \sec^ {4} x + \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot 2 \sec^ {2} x \tan x. \end{array}
$$

将它们代入所给微分方程，得

$$
\left(\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} + \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot 2 \cos^ {2} x \tan x\right) + 2 (1 - \sin x \cos x) \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + y = t,
$$

化简得

$$
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + y = t.
$$

易求得该方程的通解为 $y = (C_1 t + C_2) e^{-t} + t - 2$ . 将 $\tan x = t$ 代入，得原微分方程的通解为

$$
y = \left(C _ {1} \tan x + C _ {2}\right) e ^ {- \tan x} + \tan x - 2.
$$

cdps.prompt: 方程是欧拉型、需常数变易，还是变系数需凑微分/代换？关键转化是什么？
cdps.expected: 识别欧拉/变系数结构，作代换或常数变易求出特解。

meta.commentary: 评注 二阶变系数线性微分方程的求解，通常是作变量代换或凑微分，将其化为常系数线性微分方程或恰当方程（降阶）来求解.
